title: 人格引导的LLM智能体用于任务导向对话
summary: 该研究探讨LLM在任务导向对话中表达人格并适应用户人格的能力。提出无训练框架，模拟用户与系统智能体交互，比较中性、推断和显式三种条件。发现适应人格提升约束满足和用户满意度，但降低真实性，基于线索的推断最佳平衡个性化与任务完成。
summary_en: This paper studies whether LLMs can express personality in task-oriented dialogue and adapt to users. A training-free framework simulates interactions, comparing neutral, inferred, and explicit personality conditions. Adaptation improves constraint satisfaction and user satisfaction but lowers truthfulness; cue-based inference best balances personalization and task grounding.
